verdict.rationale: Kick is an AI-driven bookkeeping product, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never documents a training opt-out, a no-training commitment, or a data-usage control for AI models. The security docs cover only encryption, RBAC and Plaid credential handling, and the categorization docs say the AI 'learns from your changes' without any control over that learning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
